rationale.human_approval_count: Zero remains deliberate for the single-operator repository; machine gates and resolved review threads carry admission authority until an independent reviewer principal is established.
rationale.ruleset_preference: Repository rulesets expose effective branch rules through GitHub's branch-rules API, enabling read-only verification without mutation authority.
rationale.check_publisher_binding: All six live required contexts are bound to GitHub Actions integration/app id 15368; exact tuple equality prevents same-name spoofing and prevents unmodeled live checks from being silently accepted.

notes: This file is declarative; live GitHub repository settings remain enforcement authority.
Repository-level enforcement must fail closed before main is classified as production-admitted.
Required status context+publisher tuples must equal the live named-ruleset tuple set exactly.
